limitations: Seven retained fixtures establish finite byte parity, not whole-game poker accuracy or untested-mode correctness. Bridge walk and optional same-batch transport were not new control children.
Output gate acts after complete calculation/serialization buffers are built. These checks do not establish a general RAM or CPU ceiling, and nonriver input reads are not newly bounded.
